files.legacy_source_statement: DefiLlama /protocols API (https://api.llama.fi/protocols), fetched live 2026-08-04. TVL aggregated by parentProtocol within DefiLlama's own category tags: 'Dexs'; 'Lending'; 'CDP' (plus 'Basis Trading' for Ethena, which DefiLlama does not file as a CDP); and 'Liquid Staking' + 'Restaking' + 'Liquid Restaking' merged. Mechanism details for Fluid DEX, Raydium/OpenBook, Uniswap UNIfication, PancakeSwap veCAKE sunset, USDD 2.0 and Lista CDP verified by web search 2026-08-04. Marker convention used in the 'forced' arrays: CANDIDATE = candidate-register symbol, marked per contract; CONTESTED = contested-register symbol, used only with the note given; FORCED = core symbol that only approximately applies; NOT USED = symbol deliberately rejected, with reason.

DefiLlama, snapshot 2026-08-04. Perps ranked by Normalized Perp Volume 24h from https://defillama.com/perps (category totals: $17.309b 24h, $496.127b 30d, OI $17.406b). Intents/aggregation ranked by DEX Aggregator Volume 24h from https://defillama.com/dex-aggregators (category total $2.986b 24h, $78.26b 30d). Yield and Bridges ranked by TVL from https://api.llama.fi/protocols (DefiLlama categories 'Yield' + 'Yield Aggregator' and 'Bridge'). The paid-gated https://api.llama.fi/overview/derivatives endpoint returned HTTP 402, so perp volume was read off the rendered leaderboard via a stealth browser fetch. NOTE ON CONVENTION: candidate-register symbols (Sv, Dp, Fd, Gs, Rl, Of, Rs, Vl, Sd, Fz) and contested-register symbols (Zk, Ve, Da, Ua, Tw, ...) are each marked with an entry in that protocol's 'forced' array prefixed CANDIDATE-REGISTER or CONTESTED-REGISTER, since the schema provides no other marking channel. A CANDIDATE-REGISTER note is not by itself a claim of a bad fit; a CONTESTED-REGISTER note carries the required justification for use.

DefiLlama API pulled directly 2026-08-04 (api.llama.fi/protocols for TVL by category; stablecoins.llama.fi/stablecoins for circulating supply; api.llama.fi/overview/options for options notional; api.llama.fi/overview/dexs for prediction-market volume). Cross-checked RWA rankings against app.rwa.xyz/treasuries fetched 2026-08-04 ($16.17B total tokenized treasuries). Mechanism detail from protocol docs (docs.centrifuge.io, docs.maple.finance, usyc.docs.hashnote.com, docs.derive.xyz, docs.polymarket.com, gem.azuro.org) via web search 2026-08-04. Note: DefiLlama's own category taxonomy is itself evidence — 'Risk Curators' ($8.76B) and 'Onchain Capital Allocator' ($7.74B) are top-10 categories with zero vocabulary coverage.

scope: Frozen historical source inventory; source claims are not independently reverified financial facts.
